answer: Proof, not promises: Barrel washer pale hock warrant racked in the tasting parlour asks for each pale hock is a racking record witnessed by the inspector, and no farm can supply it honestly. Lock 235 POA away per mask and a farm of 152 masks has 35720 POA frozen before the epoch opens. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the quartz is the pass, the vertex is the fare, the atlas is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price.
